Women Poets of the Nineteenth Century

Heavy is the lot of woman— / Heavy is her loving lot— / If it thus must share in common / Love with those who know it not.

—
The Moorish Maiden’s Vigil
 (ll. 62–65).

Lætitia

Elizabeth Maclean

Women Poets of the Nineteenth Century

Joanna Baillie to Katharine Tynan

Edited by Alfred H. Miles

The critical biographies of 47 women such as Nairne, Hemans, Browning, Kemble, Brontë, Rossetti, and Meynell are illustrated by 403 expertly chosen verse selections.
